description: A simple tab bar at the bottom of the screen that lets you switch between different routes. Screens are lazily initialized (mounted on first focus).

usage.staticAPI: createBottomTabNavigator(config) returns a Tab Navigator object with Navigator and Screen components.
usage.dynamicAPI: Use <Tab.Navigator> and <Tab.Screen> in your component tree.

methods.Navigator: Component wrapping all tab screens and managing navigation state.
methods.Screen: Component representing an individual screen in the tab navigator.

props.backBehavior: Behavior when the back button is pressed: 'firstRoute', 'initialRoute', 'order', 'history', 'fullHistory', 'none'. Default is 'firstRoute'.
props.detachInactiveScreens: Boolean indicating whether inactive screens should be detached to save memory. Defaults to true.
props.tabBar: Function returning a custom React element to render the tab bar.
props.lazy: Boolean controlling if screens should mount lazily (default true).
props.freezeOnBlur: Boolean preventing inactive screens from re-rendering (default false).
props.popToTopOnBlur: Boolean to pop nested stack to top when switching tabs (default false).
props.sceneContainerStyle: Style object applied to the container wrapping screen content.

screenOptions.title: Fallback title for the screen.
screenOptions.tabBarLabel: Label text or function returning React Node.
screenOptions.tabBarShowLabel: Boolean controlling visibility of tab label (default true).
screenOptions.tabBarLabelPosition: 'below-icon' or 'beside-icon'. Default is automatic based on device.
screenOptions.tabBarLabelStyle: Style object for the tab label.
screenOptions.tabBarIcon: Function returning a React Node for the tab icon.
screenOptions.tabBarIconStyle: Style object for the tab icon.
screenOptions.tabBarBadge: String or number for a badge on the tab icon.
screenOptions.tabBarAccessibilityLabel: Accessibility label for the tab button.
screenOptions.tabBarButton: Function returning a React element for the tab button.
screenOptions.tabBarButtonTestID: ID for testing the tab button.
screenOptions.tabBarActiveTintColor: Color of icon and label for active tab.
screenOptions.tabBarInactiveTintColor: Color of icon and label for inactive tab.
screenOptions.tabBarHideOnKeyboard: Boolean to hide tab bar when keyboard is open (default false).
screenOptions.tabBarItemStyle: Style object for tab item container.
screenOptions.tabBarStyle: Style object for the tab bar itself.
screenOptions.tabBarBackground: Function returning React element for tab bar background.
screenOptions.header: Function returning a custom header React element for the screen.
screenOptions.headerShown: Boolean controlling visibility of the header (default true).

events.tabPress: Fired when the user presses the tab button. Can be prevented using event.preventDefault().
events.tabLongPress: Fired when the user long-presses the tab button.

hooks.useBottomTabBarHeight: Returns the height of the bottom tab bar for layout adjustments.
hooks.BottomTabBarHeightContext: Context providing the tab bar height for class components or reusable components.

animations.animation: Default transition animation when switching tabs: 'fade', 'shift', 'none' (default 'none').

transitionSpec.config: Options for timing or spring animations (duration, easing, stiffness, damping, mass, etc.)

animations.sceneStyleInterpolator: Function returning styles for screen container during transition.

notes: By default, screens are rendered lazily to optimize performance.
Use a custom tabBar function to implement your own tab bar design.
tabBarButton receives a navigation prop, not useNavigation hook.
Absolute positioning of tabBar requires padding adjustments using useBottomTabBarHeight.
